verdict.rationale: The skill ships its own dependency-free Python tools: a command-line searchable logo library, SVG auditing, PNG rendering, favicon/app-icon export and a packaging script. These are scriptable outside a chat UI. However, the core design workflow is explicitly interactive, with human checkpoints where nothing further is produced until the user picks a direction. There is also no documentation of running the skill headlessly or in CI. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive agent invocation, CI integration examples, a way to bypass or automate the human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and hands-on corroboration of automated runs.
